items.title: Fullstack Engineer
items.description: We are looking for a highly experienced and versatile Fullstack Engineer to join our dynamic team. This role requires a strong background in agile development practices, close collaboration with team members and product owners, and the ability to design and negotiate technical solutions end-to-end across the technical domain. Familiarity with AI tools and services to augment development practices is highly desirable. The Wow Our Product Development organisation spans across 5 locations, with the most creative teams in the industry! If you are passionate about the latest technologies and can handle mission-critical responsibilities, then this is the role for you! We are operating in a very competitive market therefore we MUST use latest technologies. Our aim is to create the best performance, functionality, and user experience in the iGaming industry! You will be part of a passionate team, which is building an industry leading, scalable, multi-brand platform to support 40+ online brands! Our brands are used by hundreds of thousands of users and growing. What's in it for you? Player Account Management (PAM) Area covers everything related to the management of the player accounts, such as: Account creation, verification, updates, and closure Account authentication, controls, and security User session management Responsible Gaming A taste of what you will be doing Design, develop, and maintain scalable fullstack applications using .NET (preferably .NET 9) and Angular. Integrate and manage messaging systems such as Kafka and RabbitMQ. Deploy and manage applications using Docker and Kubernetes in AWS environments. Work with various databases including PostgreSQL, MSSQL, and Couchbase. Implement search capabilities using OpenSearch or Elasticsearch. Write and maintain frontend code using TypeScript and ensure quality with Playwright or Cypress. Collaborate closely with team members and product owners in an agile environment ensuring that the organization’s business goals are met. Utilize AI tools and services to enhance development workflows and productivity. You are good at Extensive experience with .NET technologies, preferably .NET 9. Strong proficiency in Angular and TypeScript. Hands-on experience with Kafka, RabbitMQ, Docker, and Kubernetes. Proficient in working with AWS cloud services. Deep understanding of relational and NoSQL databases including PostgreSQL, MSSQL, and Couchbase. Experience with search technologies like OpenSearch or Elasticsearch. Familiarity with frontend testing frameworks such as Playwright or Cypress. Proven experience working in agile development environments. Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Extra awesome Experience designing and negotiating technical solutions across teams. Ability to design and implement end-to-end solutions across the full technology stack. Exposure to and use of AI tools and services to support software development. What we offer Much like a rollercoaster, life at Betsson Group is fast-paced, full of twists and turns, and always exciting. With more than 2,800 colleagues representing over 75 nationalities across a global network of offices - including 1,500 at our operational headquarters in Malta - every day brings new challenges and opportunities to grow. It may not be for the faint-hearted, but if you thrive on innovation, enjoy pushing boundaries and want to be part of a diverse, international team, then you’ll fit right in at Betsson. Challenge Accepted? By submitting your application, you understand that your personal data will be processed as set out in our Privacy Policy

items.title: Content Execution Coordinator
items.description: As a Content Execution Coordinator working within the Product Development Content Delivery Team, you will be part of a team that is responsible for managing the core content on our sites. The Wow In this role, you will have the opportunity to work on different sites operated by Betsson Group and to contribute to our promise to deliver the best customer experience in the industry. Reporting to the Head of Content Delivery, you will be working with our content tools to ensure all content is prepared, updated, and verified prior to the launch of projects or new product features. You will be required to gather and execute all content needed from all the Product Development vertical areas. Furthermore, you will need to work closely with Product Managers and development teams to ensure the delivery of content updates is in sync with development updates. A taster of what you will be involved with: Coordinate and execute content updates required for new site launches, new markets, site migrations, and new product features. Coordinate translations and upload the content to the Content Management System. Upload game thumbnails for Betsson Group brands. Test content prior to any release to ensure that all content is displayed correctly on site. Coordinate proofreading with different stakeholders. Communicate and document the status of your work to relevant project managers. Act as a team player, handling multiple tasks at the same time. Provide support and training as necessary to other team members, colleagues, and collaborators. Any other duties that may be required within the team. What we are looking for Excellent communication skills in English, both verbally and in writing. A fun team player capable of building positive working relationships across the company. Willingness to learn in a fast-paced environment. Have an eye for detail – you spot errors and find discrepancies on a site. Able to deliver tasks within short deadlines, to a high standard and error-free. Keep yourself motivated even when working on repetitive tasks. Able to work well even with minimal supervision. Extra Awesome Experience in the iGaming industry, including knowledge of different jurisdictions. A good knowledge of JIRA, Confluence and CMS tools is a plus. Experience in using CMS tools and Smartling What we offer Much like riding a rollercoaster, sometimes life at Betsson can be lightning fast with twists and turns but always FUN! Then again, what else would you expect from a business 75% millennial and 1700 strong, spread across 7 offices with 900 based out of our Malta HQ alone! We recognise it may not be for the faint-hearted, but if you’re a go-getter, initiator and adrenaline junkie, always striving to push the boundaries and challenge yourself, then you’ll fit right in. items.title: Senior/Principal Product Manager, User Onboarding & Growth (Crypto.com App)
items.description: Our Product Management team drives product initiatives from inception through execution, makes impacts and launches products/features across our global footprint. We collaborate closely with engineers, designers, analysts, marketers, and other cross-functional team members to ship remarkable features and products. Role Overview We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to own customer onboarding across the Crypto.com App and adjacent product surfaces. Onboarding is where regulatory requirements, customer acquisition, and time-to-first-value meet. Every improvement you ship should help more customers open an account compliantly, activate faster, and reach the products that matter. Your mandate is to own the onboarding journey as both a growth product and a regulated platform: KYC and account opening, activation and referral mechanics, new-product onboarding, and a meaningful trading scope. Within six months, you will own the onboarding-and-growth charter and take on trading product work in addition to the onboarding charter. You will report to Onboarding squad Lead and work closely on the trading portion of the charter. You will run your roadmap with independence, make prioritization calls, and own the how and the when. If you have built onboarding in a regulated consumer fintech, parts of this will feel familiar. The difference is the breadth: one onboarding platform must support a growing set of products, regulatory paths, and trading journeys. The playbook is still being written. Life @ Crypto.com Empowered to think big. Try new opportunities while working with a talented, ambitious and supportive team. Transformational and proactive working environment. Elevate employees to find thoughtful and innovative solutions. Growth from within. We help to develop new skill-sets that would impact the shaping of your personal and professional growth. Work Culture. Our colleagues are some of the best in the industry; we are all here to help and support one another. One cohesive team. Engage stakeholders to achieve our ultimate goal - Cryptocurrency in every wallet. Are you ready to kickstart your future with us? Benefits Competitive salary Medical insurance package with extended coverage to dependents Attractive annual leave entitlement including: birthday, work anniversary Work Flexibility Adoption. Flexi-work hour and hybrid or remote set-up Aspire career alternatives through us. Our internal mobility program can offer employees a diverse scope. Work Perks: crypto.com visa card provided upon joining Our Crypto.com benefits packages vary depending on region requirements, you can learn more from our talent acquisition team. About Crypto.com: Founded in 2016, Crypto.com serves more than 80 million customers and is the world's fastest growing global cryptocurrency platform. Our vision is simple: Cryptocurrency in Every Wallet™. Built on a foundation of security, privacy, and compliance, Crypto.com is committed to accelerating the adoption of cryptocurrency through innovation and empowering the next generation of builders, creators, and entrepreneurs to develop a fairer and more equitable digital ecosystem. Learn more at https://crypto.com. Crypto.com is an equal opportunities employer and we are committed to creating an environment where opportunities are presented to everyone in a fair and transparent way. Crypto.com values diversity and inclusion, seeking candidates with a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills that complement and strengthen our team. items.title: Product Operations Manager (DesignOps)
items.description: ABOUT MISTRAL Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. THE ROLE As a Product Operations Manager (Design), you will sit within Mistral's Product Operations function, with a focus on streamlining the operations of the design team. You will own how the Design team operates as a system — its cadences, its rituals, its coordination, and the connective tissue that lets designers focus on design. This role exists because a design org at our scale needs someone whose full-time job is the operating system itself: defining it, holding it, and continuously tuning it so the team runs with a heartbeat rather than on ad-hoc heroics. You will own the team's weekly and quarterly cadences — from leadership syncs to planning, retros, and share-outs — and establish how we track work, surface it outward, and make decisions. You'll design the forums where decisions get made and recorded, keep the rituals that create alignment, and aggressively cut the ones that are just overhead. Equally, you are the bridge across the org. You will coordinate the interlocks between Brand and Marketing for upcoming launches, and between Product and Product Design for the build pipeline — so interdependencies are understood and planned for, not discovered at the last minute. You will partner closely with marketing, PMs, engineering, GTM to align design work with go-to-market timing and surface what's shipping before it ships. This is a team-of-one role with a founding design-ops mentality. You will build the discipline from scratch, automate repetitive coordination with AI where it helps, and coordinate people where it matters. You report to the Head of Product Operations, working day-to-day with the Head of Design and the design team. WHAT YOU WILL DO - Define the operating system of the design team — the cadences, forums, rituals, and source-of-truth that keep the team aligned and moving forward. - Own the weekly and quarterly cadences, from leadership syncs and critiques to planning, retros, and headcount-cycle inputs. - Coordinate the Brand × Marketing and Product × Product Design interlocks so design work is surfaced with enough lead time and dependencies are planned, not discovered late. - Establish how the team tracks and shares out work — a single source of truth for status, and the forums where design is made legible to the rest of the org. - Design and hold decision-making forums so decisions get made, recorded, and not relitigated. - Separate ritual from overhead — keep the cadences that create alignment and cut the ones that are just tax. - Automate repetitive coordination, reporting, and tracking with AI so the team spends time on design, not admin. - Bring the wider Product Operations toolkit to the design team — data and analytics for transparent reporting, structured feedback loops and early-access programmes, and launch coordination that aligns design work with product release cycles and go-to-market timing. - Partner with marketing, PMs, engineering and GTM to align design work with go-to-market timing and surface what's shipping. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - 6–10 years of experience in design operations, product operations, program management, or a chief-of-staff role within a creative or product organization. - A founding design-ops mindset — you've built operational disciplines from scratch, not just maintained inherited ones. - Comfortable automating with AI tools to remove repetitive overhead, while equally skilled at coordinating people and building coalitions without authority. - Strong systems thinking — you design repeatable rhythms and processes, not just run meetings. - Design literacy — enough background to have felt the pain designers feel and to be credible with the team. - A make-it-happen attitude: positive, bias to action, unblocks rather than escalates. - Excellent communication and synthesis skills — you turn scattered signals into a shared source of truth. - Ability to thrive in ambiguity and define your own scope in a role with no playbook and no team to delegate to. WHAT WE OFFER We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks. For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page https://app.notion.com/p/mistralai/Benefits-at-Mistral-36e6ba59a7fe836b93dd01737fcc27ef?source=copy_link. PRIVACY POLICY Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy https://legal.mistral.ai/terms/applicant-privacy-policy.

items.title: Lead Salesforce Developer, GTM Systems
items.description: About Glean: Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform. With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business - without vendor lock-in or costly implementation cycles. At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities - AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level. Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50+ industries and 1,000+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality. If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more. You'll be deeply embedded where people get things done. You'll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company. About the Role: Glean is seeking a Lead Salesforce Developer – Revenue Systems to provide hands-on technical leadership for our Salesforce platform and revenue systems. You will own the technical design, development, integration, scalability, security, and reliability of Salesforce solutions supporting Sales, Revenue Operations, Partnerships, Finance, and other critical business processes. This is a hands-on engineering leadership role where you will continue to design and build solutions while also establishing engineering standards, leading technical decisions, reviewing code, mentoring developers, and improving the overall Salesforce development practice. You will: Own the technical architecture and delivery of Salesforce solutions across lead, account, contact, opportunity, partner, and revenue workflows. Design scalable Salesforce solutions spanning data models, automation, custom development, integrations, security, and reporting. Develop and maintain custom Salesforce functionality using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Flow, SOQL, SOSL, and Salesforce APIs. Evaluate business requirements and determine the appropriate configuration versus custom-development approach. Build reusable, scalable, secure, and maintainable Salesforce components and frameworks. Design, develop, and support integrations between Salesforce and third-party applications using REST, SOAP, middleware, platform APIs, and event-driven integration patterns. Establish reliable data synchronization patterns covering field mapping, integration keys, duplicate prevention, idempotency, error handling, retries, monitoring, and alerting. Troubleshoot complex integration failures, data synchronization issues, API-related problems, and platform defects. Lead technical discovery, solution design, estimation, implementation planning, and delivery for Salesforce initiatives. Conduct architecture reviews, technical design reviews, and code reviews. Define and enforce Salesforce engineering standards and best practices across coding, testing, security, documentation, version control, and release management. Mentor Salesforce developers and administrators and provide technical guidance on complex technical problems. Define and maintain Salesforce environment and sandbox strategies and support CI/CD and automated deployment practices. Lead Salesforce deployment planning, validation, rollback planning, and production readiness reviews. Establish appropriate unit, integration, regression, and deployment validation testing practices. Investigate complex Salesforce defects, integration failures, data issues, performance problems, and security concerns. Lead root-cause analysis for production incidents and implement durable solutions to recurring issues. Develop and maintain operational runbooks, troubleshooting documentation, and technical documentation. Partner with Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Finance, Marketing, Partnerships, IT, Security, and other business teams to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions. Provide technical input into roadmap planning, prioritization, vendor evaluations, and platform governance. Identify opportunities to simplify processes, improve user experience, increase automation, and maximize the value of Salesforce. Contribute to the long-term architecture and technical strategy of Glean's revenue systems ecosystem. About you: 7–10+ years of Salesforce development experience, including significant experience with enterprise Salesforce implementations. Strong hands-on experience with Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Salesforce Flow, SOQL, SOSL, and Salesforce APIs. Strong understanding of Salesforce architecture, including data modeling, object relationships, security and sharing, profiles, permission sets, access controls, automation, governor limits, performance optimization, and deployment architecture. Proven experience designing and troubleshooting REST and SOAP integrations. Experience working with middleware or integration platforms and enterprise application integrations. Strong understanding of integration patterns, error handling, retries, monitoring, observability, and data synchronization. Experience with Git and structured CI/CD or Salesforce release-management practices. Experience writing and maintaining automated tests and deployment validation processes. Experience leading technical design, architecture reviews, code reviews, and engineering standards. Strong production support, debugging, incident management, and root-cause analysis experience. Demonstrated ability to mentor developers and influence technical decisions. Strong stakeholder-management and problem-solving skills. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Location: This role is hybrid (4 days a week in our Bengaluru office) AI-First Mindset at Glean: At Glean, AI fluency is core to how we work and we're committed to ensuring every new hire feels confident integrating AI into their everyday work. As part of the interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about, design, and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today — prior Glean experience isn't required. Global Data Privacy Notice for Job Candidates and Applicants: Depending on your location, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), or other privacy laws may regulate the way we manage the data of job applicants. Our full notice outlining how data will be processed as part of the application procedure for applicable locations is available in our Privacy Policy . By submitting your application, you are agreeing to our use and processing of your data as required. US applicants and their applications are subject to arbitration of disputes as outlined in our Applicant Arbitration Agreement . By clicking “Submit Application,” I confirm that I have read the Global Data Privacy Notice and the Applicant Arbitration Agreement , and I agree to the terms.

items.title: Applied AI Architect, Partnerships
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role As a Partners Solutions Architect on Anthropic's Applied AI team, you'll be a pre-sales architect focused on building technical relationships with our Global and Regional System Integrators (GSIs/RSIs) and cloud partners (AWS and GCP). You'll strengthen these relationships to accelerate indirect revenue, enable partners' AI practices, and execute our long-term go-to-market strategy. Responsibilities Strategic technical partnership: Act as a technical thought partner to the Anthropic GTM partnerships team. Bring technical expertise to help us understand the partner landscape, drive key strategic programs, and find ways to deepen partner technical capabilities. Embed with GSI and cloud partner technical teams to enable their AI practices, support troubleshooting, and evangelize Anthropic in their developer communities. You'll also serve as an escalation point for complex technical issues. Joint solution development: Work with partners to identify high-value, industry-specific GenAI applications, develop joint solutions, and codify reference architectures and best practices that speed time to deployment. Customer deal support: Step in to unblock strategic customer deals where partners are the primary delivery vehicle, providing deep technical expertise and solution architecture guidance. Partner ecosystem and events: Represent Anthropic at partner events such as GSI customer workshops, AWS summits, and industry conferences. Lead or support partner-specific developer events, hackathons, and technical enablement sessions, especially for technically native communities. Product feedback: Gather and validate feedback on Anthropic's products and offerings, especially as they relate to partner use cases and deployment patterns. Deliver it to the relevant Anthropic teams to inform the product roadmap and partner strategy. You may be a good fit if you have 5+ years in technical customer-facing or partner-facing roles, such as Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, Partner Sales Engineer, or Technical Account Manager A track record of partnering successfully with GSIs and/or cloud providers to solve complex technical challenges, from initial solution design through customer delivery Exceptional ability to build relationships and communicate technical concepts to diverse stakeholders, including C-suite executives and engineering and IT teams Strong presentation and technical communication skills, with the ability to translate requirements between technical and business stakeholders Experience designing scalable cloud architectures and integrating with enterprise systems Familiarity with common LLM frameworks and tools, or a background in machine learning or data science Enthusiasm for cross-organizational collaboration, working through trade-offs, and balancing competing priorities A love of teaching, mentoring, and helping others succeed A passion for using technology in ways that are safe and beneficial, and that advance the goal of safe AI systems The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. items.location_text: Menlo Park, CA; New York, NY
items.description: Join us in building the future of finance. Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading. About the team + role We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. The Robinhood Crypto Product Compliance team supports Product teams in developing and launching crypto products and services in alignment with regulatory requirements. The team serves as the primary compliance partner for product initiatives, providing guidance on product design, customer communications, and operational processes related to crypto offerings. Team members work closely with Product, Legal, Risk, Marketing, and Operations teams to support compliant product launches and ongoing enhancements. This team plays a key role in helping Robinhood deliver crypto experiences that meet customer needs while maintaining strong regulatory standards! As Crypto Product Compliance Lead , you will support the development and enhancement of Robinhood’s crypto products and services. You will lead initiatives responsible for reviewing product designs, customer communications, and operational processes to support compliance with applicable regulations and firm policies. The role includes advising teams throughout the product lifecycle, from ideation through launch and post-launch enhancements. You will also work closely with Product, Legal, Risk, and Operations partners to support regulatory reviews, examinations, and business initiatives related to crypto products. This role is based in our New York, NY and Menlo Park, CA offices, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week. At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. What you’ll do Partner with Product teams and other business partners, including Legal, Risk, and Operations, during the design, testing, launch, and enhancement of crypto products and services. Advise on regulatory requirements and operational processes related to crypto products, including consumer protection, AML, sanctions, and financial crimes compliance considerations. Develop appropriate compliance framework for new products. Review product features, customer communications, and marketing materials to support compliance with applicable regulatory requirements and firm policies. Provide timely guidance to business partners on compliance questions, regulatory developments, and product-related issues. Support regulatory examinations, inquiries, filings, and internal compliance reviews, including developing and executing compliance testing and monitoring, related to Robinhood Crypto products. What you bring Passion for Robinhood’s mission to democratize finance for all and interest in crypto products and financial technology. 7+ years of experience in financial services, including experience supporting crypto products within compliance, risk, legal, audit, or operations functions. Experience with brokerage products. Awareness of anti-money laundering, sanctions, and financial crimes compliance requirements related to crypto products. Experience advising on consumer protection requirements. Experience advising on DeFi projects. Strong understanding of MiFID requirements is required. Ability to manage projects and coordinate work across technical and non-technical teams in a regulated environment. Strong written and verbal communication skills with experience presenting compliance guidance to business partners and leadership teams. Familiarity with global crypto regulatory frameworks, including MiCA, is a plus. Familiarity with traditional brokerage is a plus. Insatiable curiosity. What we offer Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career. Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching. Top Tier benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents. Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not. Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more. Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits. Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more! Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces. In addition to the base pay range listed below, this role is also eligible for bonus opportunities + equity + benefits. If our mission energizes you and you’re ready to build the future of finance, we look forward to seeing your application. AI Usage Disclosure: Robinhood uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of our recruiting process. These tools enhance the efficiency and consistency of our hiring process; however, all hiring decisions are made by our hiring teams. Robinhood provides equal opportunity for all applicants, offers reasonable accommodations upon request, and complies with applicable equal employment and privacy laws. items.title: Staff Software Engineer (Platform - Financial Engineering)
items.description: Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase , we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” Learn more about working at Coinbase . Staff Software Engineer, Fullstack - Finance Engineering Platform (L6) As a Staff Software Engineer on the Finance Engineering Platform team within the Platform group, you'll own the frontend technical direction for the systems that transform trading, payment, and transfer activity into accurate financial records. This team builds the internal control plane where Finance and Accounting teams monitor financial health, investigate reconciliation breaks, and take governed action. You'll turn ambiguous operational problems into cohesive, scalable user experiences and establish the patterns that enable Finance to operate with greater speed, accuracy, and confidence. What you'll do: Own the frontend technical strategy and architecture for financial reconciliation and operations products, including React and TypeScript applications for high-volume financial data, tables, filtering, visualizations, and transaction-level investigation. Lead the design of auditable human-in-the-loop workflows covering validation, approval states, error handling, permissions, and review history. Define end-to-end contracts with backend and API teams so that new data capabilities become reliable, understandable product features. Establish best practices for frontend quality across testing, accessibility, performance, observability, feature management, and safe rollout. Drive the most ambiguous and high-impact initiatives, creating technical clarity and alignment across engineering, product, design, and Finance stakeholders. Partner directly with Finance and Accounting users to translate operational pain points into a clear product and technical roadmap, while mentoring engineers and raising the team's technical bar. Required Skills and Experience: 8+ years of software engineering experience, including significant experience building and shipping production web applications with React and TypeScript, with fullstack capability across frontend and backend services. Demonstrated track record leading ambiguous, cross-functional projects from problem definition through design, implementation, rollout, and iteration. Deep frontend architecture expertise including state management, API integration, performance optimization, accessibility, testing, and observability. Experience building data-rich operational products, enterprise software, or workflow systems where accuracy and user trust are essential (financial systems, reconciliation, or payments domain experience preferred). History of influencing technical direction across organizational boundaries and creating durable alignment among stakeholders with different priorities through written technical designs and product discussions. Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality. Pay Transparency Notice: Base salary varies by location (see range below). Total compensation may also include equity and bonus eligibility, and benefits (medical, dental, vision, 401(k)). items.title: Group Product Manager, Money Movement
items.description: Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase , we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” Learn more about working at Coinbase . Team/ Role Paragraph: FinHub owns how money moves at Coinbase. Every dollar and token that enters, leaves, or moves within the company runs through this platform - fiat across ACH, wires, cards, RTP, and SEPA, crypto across dozens of blockchain networks, and internal movement across ledgers, legal entities, and customer accounts. As a Group Product Manager on the FinHub team within Platform , you'll own the systems that ensure every fund flow reaches a correct terminal state - the controls that stop unsafe movement, the detection that catches what slips through, and the remediation that recovers it. You'll set the reliability standard for money movement at Coinbase and lead through influence to hold the company to it. What you’ll do: Own the multi-year vision and strategy for money movement reliability and controls across fiat and crypto, defining per-rail service levels and resolution targets for every fund flow. Build the controls infrastructure governing money movement - determining which risk, compliance, and financial controls apply to each flow, verifying they ran, and confirming they passed before funds move. Drive real-time detection and end-to-end tracing across payment rails, blockchain networks, controls, and the ledger to identify and resolve failures fast. Scale correctness through AI agents that propose controls from product specs, triage alerts before an engineer opens them, and remediate within governed limits. Partner with Compliance, Risk, Finance, and every product group that moves money to establish control ownership and hold teams accountable for their fund flows. Required Skills and Experience: 10+ years of product management experience, with deep expertise in money movement, payments infrastructure, ledgering, or financial platforms at scale. Track record owning strategy for large-scale money movement or financial systems - payment processing, transfers, ledgers, reconciliation, or the reliability layers around them. Deep technical fluency in distributed systems, event streaming, idempotency, double-entry ledgering, reconciliation, and the design of preventive and detective controls. Demonstrated ability to set standards that other teams must meet and make them stick across organizational boundaries in a highly regulated environment. Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality. items.title: Commercial Counsel, Hardware
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role Hardware is becoming critical to how AI gets built, and the legal questions are as new as the technology. We're hiring a Commercial Counsel, Hardware to help Anthropic's product teams move fast, build safely, and get the legal calls right. In this role, you'll negotiate a high volume of fast-moving deals for hardware, components, software, and emerging technology procurement needs. This role will also lead multifaceted technology, data, and partnership deals, many of them the first of their kind at Anthropic. You'll be the legal and risk partner that technical and business leaders turn to when they need a fast, practical read on a deal or purchase. You'll clear low risk transactions quickly, spot the ones that deserve a closer look, and build scalable solutions as new complexities come up, all while working alongside Procurement and Finance and Legal colleagues in areas like privacy, IP, and trade. Along the way, you'll also support partnerships with major tech companies, universities, and media organizations, which gives you a view across much of the business. Key responsibilities Negotiate and close a high volume of agreements for hardware and components, including review of embedded firmware and companion software licenses Structure and negotiate complex technology, data, and partnership agreements Track legal and regulatory changes that affect hardware products and components, such as product safety rules and restrictions on foreign-made components, and explain what they mean for our plans Identify trade, export control, sanctions, and supply chain concerns in cross-border sourcing, and work with our national security and compliance teams to resolve them Build and maintain self-serve guidance, templates, and AI-assisted review tools so routine purchases don't wait on Legal Manage outside counsel for specialist questions and overflow volume Cover other technology or hardware transactions on the Legal team as needed Minimum qualifications Hold a law degree (JD, LLB, or equivalent) and meet the local licensing requirements to work as in-house counsel where you'll be based Hands-on experience buying hardware and firmware, components, and software in high volume, fast-paced environments Deep experience leading complex deals, such as technology or data licensing, joint development, or supply partnerships Working knowledge of international supply chains and how sourcing choices (and their associated risks) show up in contracts (lead times, single-source risk, warranties, country of origin, higher risk jurisdictions) Working knowledge of trade and regulatory compliance for hardware, including export controls, sanctions, tariffs and customs Clear, plain communication with scientists, engineers, and operators, so legal risk turns into a decision they can act on A low-ego, "doer" attitude and real interest in taking on work outside your core practice area Intense curiosity about AI and emerging hardware, and a commitment to responsible AI development Preferred qualifications At least 8 years of legal experience in hardware or a closely related technical space, with the judgment to run risk assessments and deals on your own from day one In-house time at a hardware-intensive technology company (such as electronics, industrial automation, or complex devices) while it was scaling quickly Experience supporting product or engineering teams as a dedicated counsel Experience with facilities or on-site vendor services, including the insurance and safety questions An engineering, product, or other technical background Experience using AI tools to speed up your own legal work Role-specific policy: For this role, we expect all staff to be able to work from our San Francisco office at least 3 days a week, though we encourage you to apply even if you might need some flexibility for an interim period of time. The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. items.title: Dedicated Support Engineer - Toronto
items.description: About the Team OpenAI’s User Operations team shepherds our customers’ adoption of AI and ensures that our customers' product experience is nothing short of exceptional. We are building the very first post-AGI support team. We resolve complex issues, provide technical guidance, and support customers in maximizing value and adoption from deploying our products. We work closely with Sales, Technical Success, Product, Engineering and others, to deliver the best possible experience to our customers at scale. OpenAI's customers represent a range of diverse backgrounds and maturity, from early-stage startups to established global enterprises. About the Role The Support Engineering team works closely with Engineering, Product, Technical Success, Go-to-Market, and other teams to deliver an exceptional experience for our most strategic customers. We combine deep technical troubleshooting with durable customer context, proactive reliability work, and clear ownership during critical moments. We use automation, agents, and our own technology to help build the future of technical support. We’re looking for experienced, deeply curious technical problem-solvers to serve as trusted support partners for our Premium Support customers. You’ll work directly with customers on novel, ambiguous, and high-impact technical issues, using logs, telemetry, reproduction, and systems-level investigation to isolate causes and drive issues toward resolution. Beyond resolving individual issues, you’ll use your deep understanding of OpenAI’s infrastructure and products, together with each customer’s architecture and operating context, to anticipate risk and make their workloads more resilient over time. items.title: Data Analyst, Regulatory Analytics and Reporting
items.location_text: United Kingdom, Brazil, Ireland, Romania, Cyprus, Portugal, Lithuania, Czech Republic, Canada, Poland
items.description: BUILDING THE FUTURE OF OPEN FINANCE Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system. THE TEAM Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients. We're looking for a Data Analyst, Regulatory Analytics and Reporting to join our team remotely! The #1 goal of this role is to turn complex compliance and regulatory data into clear, actionable insights that protect the business, satisfy regulators, and support senior leadership in making high-stakes decisions. You'll work at the intersection of data engineering, regulatory reporting, and compliance operations in a fast-paced, high-scrutiny environment where accuracy and audit-readiness are non-negotiable. Beyond technical expertise, success in this role depends on being a true business partner who combines data-driven insights with deep knowledge of compliance regulations and frameworks. You'll own end-to-end data management from building and maintaining datasets and pipelines to designing dashboards and insights for compliance and leadership teams. You will also automate compliance processes and workflows to boost efficiency and minimize human error. If you combine exceptional data analysis expertise with solid knowledge of compliance regulations, a keen eye for regulatory risk, and the drive to shape the future of crypto with a top-tier brand - this is your next mission! THE OPPORTUNITY - Own the design of dashboards, compliance metrics, and regulatory reports, turning data into actionable insights for stakeholders, cross-functional partners, and regional compliance officers - Automate end to end compliance related data solutions, governance controls, and automations to boost efficiency and minimize manual intervention - Dive into large, complex datasets to turn findings into scalable, audit-ready data models that facilitate regulatory reporting and analytics - Translate regulatory and business requests into accurate reports and automated data pipelines using Python, SQL, DBT and Airflow - Lead cross-functional projects with analysts, engineers, and compliance teams to build and maintain high-quality data pipelines and sources - Coordinate client data quality monitoring by identifying issues, flagging remediations, and partnering with responsible teams to ensure timely resolution - Support ad-hoc data requests for audits, exams, risk assessments, and day-to-day business needs - Deliver insights that shape compliance direction through clear, data-driven storytelling WHAT YOU BRING - 5+ years of experience in data analysis and data management within financial services or a regulated industry, with hands-on experience in compliance and regulatory reporting across frameworks such as AML, KYC, Sanctions, MiCA, or MiFID - Solid understanding of regulatory risk and the ability to operate effectively in high-scrutiny, audit-ready environments - Expert SQL skills including complex joins, CTEs, and analytical functions, paired with proficiency in Python libraries such as pandas, matplotlib, and plotly - Hands-on experience using dbt or similar tooling to model and organize high fidelity data for reporting and decision-making - Experience setting up and managing data pipelines with a strong understanding of data workflow orchestration - Proficiency with BI and data visualization tools such as QuickSight, Power BI, or Superset to build executive-facing dashboards - Strong communicator who can simplify complex data ideas for both technical and non-technical audiences - Alignment with the values outlined in Kraken's Tentaclements document NICE TO HAVES - Degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Finance, Information Systems, or a related technical field - Passion for continuous learning and approaching problems with a beginner's mindset - Solid understanding of the cryptocurrency space and how financial markets function Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis. Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution. We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance. OUR COMMITMENT Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto. We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision. As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws. Stay connected Follow us on Twitter https://twitter.com/krakenfx Learn on the Kraken Blog https://blog.kraken.com/#:~:text=Enter%20your%20email%20address Connect on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/kraken-exchange/ Candidate Privacy Notice https://www.kraken.com/legal/candidate-privacy-notice

items.title: Product Designer, Safeguards
items.location_text: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY | Seattle, WA
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role Design at Anthropic sits at the intersection of craft, research, and product intuition. We're a small team working on products that millions of people use daily—and on interactions that don't have established conventions yet. Our work shapes how people experience AI: whether Claude feels like a tool or a collaborator, whether it earns trust or erodes it. We partner closely with engineers and researchers, often designing around capabilities that are emerging in real-time. That means staying close to the models, prototyping rapidly, and being comfortable with ambiguity. We're looking for designers who ship fast and stay in motion—people who would rather get something in front of users this week than perfect it for a month. You're excited to question fundamental UI assumptions and invent patterns that feel native to AI, and you're already using tools like Claude Code to extend what you can build. You pay attention to where model capabilities are heading, not just what Claude can do today, and you find ways to keep caring about the pixels, the copy, and the edge cases while shipping quickly. Key responsibilities Collaborate with product managers, engineers, AI researchers and other stakeholders to define product vision, strategy and roadmaps, and play an active role in shipping. Understand the technical architecture of our products and define primitives for new capabilities. Define feature areas with exceptional attention to detail and polish, identifying opportunities to improve quality and consistency of broader flows Craft beautiful, polished, and delightful user interfaces that build trust and showcase the power of our AI technology Comfortable in code, design, prototypes, and learning new ways to communicate ideas and concepts Find creative ways to ship high-quality work in a fast-paced, often ambiguous, resource-constrained startup environment Minimum qualifications Experience designing and shipping complex workflows, enterprise/B2B SaaS, developer tools, or API products end-to-end Proven track record of executing end-to-end on large and complex products, or a series of products, in ambiguous environments A portfolio demonstrating user-centered design thinking and polished UI craftsmanship Proficiency with modern design and prototyping tools, such as Figma Experience using AI tools such as Claude Code as a creative partner in your own design practice Excellent collaboration and communication skills to work effectively with cross-functional teams and influence without authority Preferred qualifications Experience prototyping with front-end code (e.g., HTML/CSS/JS) Passion for crafting scaled, highly impactful, safe and beneficial artificial intelligence technologies to enable new possibilities The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $305,000 — $460,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

items.title: Research Engineer - Cybersecurity (RL Environments)
items.description: ABOUT MISTRAL Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. THE ROLE Cybersecurity is one of the areas where AI could do the most good — and one where the capability must be built with particular care. As a Research Engineer on this track, you'll push our models' capabilities in vulnerability discovery and remediation, security analysis, incident response, and across the offensive-to-defensive spectrum of cybersecurity, and it will be your job to develop that ability deliberately and safely. The work sits at the meeting point of research and engineering: you'll devise new approaches and be the one to implement them. Concretely, that means designing and building RL environments that reproduce realistic security scenarios, pipelines that generate synthetic training instances at scale, and experiments and evaluations that show what our models can actually do. Your results feed directly into the production training runs that shape our frontier models, in close collaboration with Mistral's researchers, engineers, and security specialists. Security specialists and ML engineers are both welcome here — what matters is that you can hold your own in both worlds, and are eager to go deeper on the one you know less. WHAT YOU WILL DO - Design and implement RL environments simulating cybersecurity scenarios. - Build the pipelines and infrastructure that generate synthetic cybersecurity training instances at scale — thousands of scenarios, not one hand-crafted exercise. - Conduct experiments and evaluations of model capabilities on these environments, from quick prototypes to controlled benchmark runs. - Own the infrastructure behind the environments: containers, sandboxes, VMs, cloud deployments, and orchestration (Kubernetes), all managed as code. - Partner with researchers and security specialists across Mistral, distilling their domain expertise into reproducible environments and datasets. - Write clear, efficient code in Python and enforce strong software-design practices: testing, code review, CI/CD. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - Hands-on expertise in offensive and/or defensive cybersecurity: vulnerability analysis, web/network/cloud security, secure coding practices, and SOC. - Strong software engineering skills: clean, reliable, well-tested code — not just exploit scripts. - Fluency in Python plus comfort reading lower-level languages (C/C++) for vulnerability analysis. - DevOps experience: Docker, Kubernetes, cloud deployments, sandboxed or simulated environments. - A pragmatic research-to-engineering mindset: ship a working first version, then refine and scale it. - Working knowledge of RL techniques and LLM training methodologies, or strong motivation to develop it. - Self-starter, low-ego, collaborative — comfortable working across research and engineering. NICE-TO-HAVES - CTF, cyber-range, or bug-bounty experience — as a player, challenge author, or platform builder. - A research background in cybersecurity, academic or industrial, or in another experimental discipline. - Prior experience building RL environments or large-scale ML training infrastructure. - Relevant open-source contributions and projects. WHAT WE OFFER We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks. For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page https://app.notion.com/p/mistralai/Benefits-at-Mistral-36e6ba59a7fe836b93dd01737fcc27ef?source=copy_link. PRIVACY POLICY Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy https://legal.mistral.ai/terms/applicant-privacy-policy.

items.title: Applied AI Engineer, Robotics
items.description: ABOUT MISTRAL Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. ABOUT THE JOB Mistral AI is seeking an Applied AI Engineer focused on robotics deployment. You will take state-of-the-art AI models and make them work on real robots, in real environments, for real customers. This is a hands-on role at the intersection of machine learning and physical systems: you will own the path from model to deployed autonomy, working alongside robotics engineers, ML researchers, and systems engineers to deliver end-to-end autonomous solutions across diverse use cases. WHAT YOU WILL DO - Integrate AI models with robotic hardware, sensors, and embedded systems, bringing modern perception and language-driven capabilities onto physical platforms. - Improve the robustness, reliability, and safety of robotic systems operating in real-world, unstructured environments. - Test and validate algorithms in simulation and in real-world deployments, moving fluidly between the two. - Analyze field data to improve model performance and system reliability, closing the loop between what happens on the robot and what happens in training. - Bring up, tune, and debug the autonomy stack — localization, mapping, navigation, and perception — on real hardware, from sensor calibration to real-time performance. - Develop and tune robot navigation behaviors — path planning, obstacle avoidance — so systems hold up in dynamic, cluttered, and partially observable environments. - Diagnose failures end-to-end: mapping drift, localization dropouts, perception edge cases, timing issues — and fix them. - Collaborate with robotics engineers, ML researchers, and systems engineers to deliver complete autonomous solutions for customer use cases, from prototype through production deployment. - Build and maintain the tooling needed for deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement of deployed systems. items.title: Partner Manager, Microsoft Co-sell
items.location_text: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY | Seattle, WA
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role Claude is available to enterprises through Microsoft Foundry, and the Microsoft partnership has become one of our most important paths to market. Many of the largest enterprises in financial services, healthcare and life sciences, and the public sector buy Microsoft first, and we want Claude to be the obvious choice when they do. As Partner Manager for Microsoft Co-Sell, you will turn that partnership into pipeline and closed revenue. You will build and run joint sales plays with Microsoft's field organization, connect Anthropic account executives with their Microsoft counterparts on shared target accounts, and make sure deals that start in a co-sell conversation actually close through Azure Marketplace. You will own your work end to end, from the details of a single stuck deal to the executive readout on how the partnership is performing. Key responsibilities Own the co-sell engine day to day: design joint sales plays with Microsoft around the strongest enterprise use cases, run account mapping with Microsoft sellers, and turn introductions into working groups and joint opportunities that show up as pipeline Keep deals moving through Azure Marketplace, including private offers, billing setup, and partner attribution; track every opportunity through that process, know where it is stuck and who needs to act, and work with both sides until it closes Run the regular pipeline and escalation rhythm with Microsoft Give Anthropic and Microsoft leaders a clear view of what is working and what is blocked Bring field insight back to our product and go-to-market teams Own at least one major joint initiative with Microsoft, such as a flagship event, a product workstream, or deal operations Minimum qualifications Experience owning a revenue or pipeline number through a partner or co-sell motion, with results you can point to Working knowledge of how enterprise deals transact through a cloud marketplace, including hands-on experience unblocking stuck deals Strong attention to detail and operational rigor, with the ability to turn that detail into a clear, concise story for executives A record of taking full ownership of your work: closing loops and keeping stakeholders informed proactively Ability to keep a stalled deal or program moving through repeated blockers until it is resolved Ability to build trust across a large, matrixed partner organization, with field sellers and their leaders alike Preferred qualifications Experience selling or partnering around AI, ML, or developer platform products Direct experience with Microsoft's partner ecosystem, such as Partner Center, Azure Marketplace, and the co-sell program Experience selling into financial services, healthcare and life sciences, or the public sector The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $215,000 — $300,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues.
